source: session tool catalogue and declared argument schemas
notes: Classification is based on declared operations; no client-wide permission settings were changed.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__book
tools.operation: Create a new booking. Requires service_id, provider_id, start_datetime and client information.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__call_support
tools.operation: Open the live support chat so the user can talk to a human support agent. Use this when the user explicitly asks to speak with support, a human, or an agent.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__cancel_booking
tools.operation: Cancel an existing booking by its ID.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_category
tools.operation: Create a new service category in the system. Plugin: "event_category"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_client
tools.operation: Create a new client. Use get_client_fields first to get available fields if custom client fields are enabled.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_intake_form
tools.operation: Create a new intake form field that clients must fill in when booking. Plugin: "event_field"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_location
tools.operation: Create a new location in the system. Plugin: "location"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_provider
tools.operation: Create a new provider in the system

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__create_service
tools.operation: Create a new service in the system

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_category
tools.operation: Delete a service category from the system. Plugin: "event_category"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_client
tools.operation: Delete a client by ID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_intake_form
tools.operation: Delete an intake form field and all its collected values. Plugin: "event_field"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_location
tools.operation: Delete a location from the system. Plugin: "location"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_provider
tools.operation: Delete a provider from the system. If the provider has been used in bookings, it will be set as inactive instead of being permanently deleted.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_service
tools.operation: Delete a service from the system. If the service has been used in bookings, it will be set as inactive instead of being permanently deleted.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__delete_special_day
tools.operation: Clears (cancel) a special day for company, provider, or service so the date reverts to the regular weekly schedule.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__disable_plugin
tools.operation: Disable a custom feature(plugin)ss

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__edit_booking
tools.operation: Edit an existing booking. Allows changing service, provider, category, location, and datetime.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__enable_plugin
tools.operation: Enable a custom feature(plugin)

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__fallback_ai_help
tools.operation: Returns AI generated help content from the Help Center, according to user query.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__finish_session
tools.operation: Finish session to clean session and disconnect user

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_bookings
tools.operation: Search bookings by various filters. Returns matching bookings and a link to full report.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_categories_list
tools.operation: Get a list of all service categories with optional filtering. Plugin: "event_category"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_category_item
tools.operation: Get a single service category by its ID. Plugin: "event_category"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_client
tools.operation: Get detailed information about a specific client by ID, including custom fields if enabled.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_client_fields
tools.operation: Get available client fields including custom fields if the client_field plugin is enabled. Use this to know which fields to include when creating or updating clients.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_company_info
tools.operation: Get company information including social links, hide email setting and WhatsApp

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_first_available_time
tools.operation: Get the first available date and time for booking. Can optionally filter by provider and/or service.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_intake_form_item
tools.operation: Get a single intake form field by its ID. Plugin: "event_field"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_intake_forms_list
tools.operation: Get a list of all intake form fields configured for this company. Plugin: "event_field"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_invoice_list
tools.operation: List invoices with optional filters. Returns matching rows, total count and a link to the invoices list. Plugin: "paid_events"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_location_item
tools.operation: Get a single location by its ID. Plugin: "location"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_locations_list
tools.operation: Get a list of all locations with optional filtering. Plugin: "location"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_outstanding_balance_list
tools.operation: Get a list of clients with outstanding (unpaid) balances. Supports filtering by client and amount range. Returns matching rows, total count and a link to the full report. Plugin: "paid_events"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_plugin_info
tools.operation: Get the info of a custom feature (plugin)

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_plugins_list
tools.operation: Get a list of custom features (plugins)

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_provider_item
tools.operation: Get a single provider by its ID

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_providers_list
tools.operation: Get a list of all providers with optional filtering

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_recommended_plugins_list
tools.operation: Get a paginated list of recommended disabled custom features (plugins), ordered by relevance to the company's business category

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_sales_and_tax_report
tools.operation: Get a sales and tax report aggregated by date for a given period. Returns daily rows (amount without tax, tax, amount with tax), totals, totals by payment processor, and a link to the full report. Plugin: "paid_events"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_schedule
tools.operation: Get schedule (working days and hours) for week. Can retrieve provider, service, or company schedule. Returns schedule information including working hours, breaks, and day-off status.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_service_item
tools.operation: Get a single service by its ID

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_services_list
tools.operation: Get a list of all services with optional filtering

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__get_timeline
tools.operation: Get available time slots for a specific date. Returns list of available booking times. Can optionally filter by provider and/or service.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__search_clients
tools.operation: Search for clients by name, email, or phone number. Returns a list of matching clients.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_category
tools.operation: Update an existing service category in the system. Plugin: "event_category"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_client
tools.operation: Update an existing client. Use get_client_fields first to get available fields if custom client fields are enabled.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_company_info
tools.operation: Update company information. Supports partial updates — only provided fields are changed.

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_intake_form
tools.operation: Update an existing intake form field. Plugin: "event_field"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_location
tools.operation: Update an existing location in the system. Plugin: "location"

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_provider
tools.operation: Update an existing provider in the system

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_schedule
tools.operation: Updates schedule for service/provider/company

tools.name: mcp__simplybook_admin__update_service
tools.operation: Update an existing service in the system
